# Peak Lead Platform
> Lead capture, configurable scoring, and a daily call list for small remodeling and trade teams. Operated by The Tripple Z; founder Zach DeKraai.

Last updated: November 21, 2026.

## Product
Peak organizes incoming inquiries, assignments, pipeline stages, and follow-up priorities. Scores start at 25 and add configured points for urgency, buying readiness, phone, and notes, capped at 100. Scores are not sale probabilities. Website forms, Google lead-form webhooks, and custom webhooks are available; native Facebook/Instagram connections remain pending approval.

## Pricing and trial
One business subscription, normally USD 200/month; team invitations are included without per-seat subscription charges. A new-business introductory offer is limited to the first 10 trial activations: 14 days free, then USD 99/month for the first two paid months, then USD 200/month. Availability is confirmed by /api/plan and Stripe checkout; existing and returning subscriptions are excluded. A 14-day trial starts after Stripe checkout activation with a payment method. Auto-renews unless canceled before renewal through Billing > Manage Subscription. Check the pricing page and live plan endpoint for current terms and price.

## Accuracy
Homepage example leads are fictional demonstrations, not customer results. No public customer count, testimonial, review rating, SOC 2 certification, US-only residency guarantee, or guaranteed sales outcome is claimed. Contact support@peakleadplatform.com for product questions.
